name: AttributeError when titling a chat session from a keyword query
true_cause: A commit changed how new chat sessions are titled; the branch for questions without a '?' reads req.qestion, an attribute that does not exist, so keyword-style queries crash with AttributeError (HTTP 500) while normal questions work. Linters do not see attribute typos.
expected_fix: Fix the attribute name (req.qestion -> req.question) in the session-title branch.
